requirement:
`habeas mdbook` MUST automatically generate exactly one execution-coverage
subchapter under the requirements index of
{cite}`requirements.index.chapter`, whether that requirements index is
explicitly placed or automatically generated.
rationale:
The subject has one obligation. `habeas mdbook` MUST generate exactly one execution-coverage subchapter under the requirements index. That holds whether the index is explicitly placed or automatically generated. The tests cover both placements and check the count.

- **Explicit directive.** `src/index.rs#mod[tests]/fn[index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters]` places a `{requirements-index}` chapter. It filters the index's `sub_items` for chapters named "Coverage gaps" and asserts `coverage.len() == 1`. It also asserts the path `appendix/requirements-index/coverage.md`, `parent_names == ["Requirements index"]`, and a link to the chapter in the index content. The "exactly one" count and the "under the index" placement are both enforced.
- **Automatic index.** `src/lib.rs#mod[tests]/fn[definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages]` has no marker, so the default index is generated. It asserts exactly one "Coverage gaps" subchapter under the generated index, with path `requirements-index/coverage.md` and the right parent name. It also checks the index link to that chapter and the detail-page ordering.
- **Hierarchy inheritance.** `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[generated_reports_inherit_the_requirements_index_hierarchy]` runs with and without section numbers. It asserts the coverage chapter sits under the index with the inherited parent names, path and numbering. It also asserts `parent.sub_items.len() == 2`, which is the existing Guide child plus exactly one coverage chapter. This rules out duplicate generation.
- **Population.** `fn[filtered_runs_union_latest_attempts_and_invalidate_with_saved_source]` is marked `{test}` for this requirement. It checks that the coverage content is populated and that the `{coverage-index}` placeholder is replaced.

A mutation that omitted the chapter, generated it twice, or put it outside the index would fail one of these assertions in both the explicit and default modes. The cited `requirements.index.chapter` is context only. Its explicit and default-generation modes are the two modes tested above. I found no unacknowledged gap.

text: `habeas mdbook` MUST automatically generate exactly one execution-coverage
subchapter under the requirements index of

An mdBook chapter MAY contain one standalone `{requirements-index}` directive with an empty body, opened by at least three colons and closed by at least as many. A book MUST contain no more than one such directive. `habeas mdbook` MUST render a requirements index listing all requirements defined in rendered chapters, each linking to its evidence detail page under {cite}`requirements.index.detail_pages`. When a directive is present, it MUST replace the directive with the index table; otherwise, it MUST generate the chapter specified by {cite}`requirements.index.chapter.default`.
